disqualifier.note: Independent event latches: parserEnded is the tar Parser end event; completed is the Effect resume-once latch. failWith can set completed before parserEnded; finish waits for parserEnded with completed still false while openEntries drain. All four combinations occur.

Not one scope: fileTouched is the per-file dirty flag in the sourceFile loop; renamed is a nested ensureNamespaceImport return latch. A file can be touched without a rename, and rename is counted separately via aliasRenamed.
